name: RBF Volume Encoding and Adaptive Octree Spatial Decomposition
definition: A method to encode volumetric scalar data as a weighted sum of Radial Basis Functions (RBFs) to allow on-the-fly reconstruction on the GPU, using an adaptive octree to store lists of relevant basis functions per spatial region to reduce evaluation count.
summary: RBF Volume Encoding and Adaptive Octree Spatial Decomposition encodes volumetric data as Radial Basis Functions stored in an adaptive octree, eliminating large grids and enabling interactive procedural reconstruction during rendering.
